name: slack-project-assistant
goal: Prove one scoped Slack assistant receives channel mentions and direct messages and composes the configured QA and canvas ports without touching live services.

evidence: Prove authenticated Slack mention and DM thread routing with stubbed transports, read-only default and a separately approved live cutover. Red: Slack subscription DM handler called zero times.
Config and Slack assistant runner, channel and DM replies, scoped file and canvas operations, GitHub QA label polling and staging revision check, and a native video recipe port.

Slack DM regression: 0 deliveries on e3e3e58b35 before repair, 1 valid same-thread delivery after repair. Focused primary-Mac tests: 42 passed across 11 files, including Slack media, canvas recovery and QA deployment/event fixtures. CLI process E2E is separate on MB2.
